quotes.text: For the fourth quarter of 2026, AMD expects revenue to be approximately $17 billion, plus or minus 3%.
Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be approximately 55%.
we expect growth to accelerate further in the fourth quarter as we scale Helios and ‘Venice’ production
Our fourth-quarter outlook reflects accelerating revenue and earnings growth, driven by strong demand across our Data Center portfolio.

Gross margin was 54% and 52% for the three months ended September 26, 2026 and September 27, 2025, respectively, where the increase was driven by a favorable product mix, including higher Data Center segment revenue.

Government actions and regulations, including export controls, national-security-based regulations, import tariffs and trade protection measures, may limit our ability to export our products to certain customers, increase costs, harm our competitive position and materially affect our business.
